title: Thanatos Echo
description: A paranoia mod that adds agony and fear of death.
body:
**Not compatible with OptiFine!!!**

**_Thanatos Echo is a hardcore horror mod for Minecraft 1.21.1_** that reimagines death and survival. It transforms low health into a deep psychological thriller, where your greatest enemy isn't monsters, but your primal fear.

_**Panic State (Health < 35%)**_
As your life force depletes, your mind becomes clouded.

Tunnel Vision: Your FOV changes, causing you to lose your bearings.

Auditory Hallucinations: You hear a growing heartbeat and frightening sounds: footsteps behind you, whispers, and the echo of your own name.

Healing Lockout: While in a panic state, your body's regeneration is disabled. Fear literally prevents you from licking your wounds.

**_Agony State (Health < 15%)_**
This is the line between life and death. The body stops obeying:

Paralysis: The resource character sits on the ground (Shift) and gains the advantage of building and jumping.

Tremor: The camera begins to shake violently, simulating shock.

Stupor: Your interaction speed with the world drops to zero—you cannot break blocks until you recover.

Trembling Hands: There's a 15% chance you'll drop the item you're holding.

_**Soul Trauma**__**_
Death in Echoes of Thanatos has long-term consequences. Each death irreparably damages your actions:

You respawn with your maximum health intact (-1 heart per death).

**
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The lower your health, the faster you'll panic the next time.

</details>

**
